prompt.project_info: Create a high-fashion luxury editorial portrait in a minimalist white studio with floating stone steps and a tonal portrait artwork.
prompt.main_subject: An adult woman with an approved adult face-and-style reference, soft natural waves, and a warm joyful expression sits or reclines elegantly on floating white stone steps. She wears a delicate soft-pink tailored skirt suit with refined texture and clear pointed-toe pumps.
prompt.composition_elements: Reclining pose across geometric floating steps, minimalist white studio, large-scale tonal portrait artwork behind her in abstract brushstrokes, calm balanced luxury composition.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Professional soft studio lighting highlights facial features, suit texture, stone geometry, and artwork; refined calm high-fashion atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: Ultra-high-detail hyper-realistic editorial photography, natural proportions, clean white tonal palette with soft pink accent, crisp wardrobe texture, no rendered text or logos.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: High-fashion luxury editorial portrait of an adult woman with an approved adult face-and-style reference, soft natural waves and a warm joyful gentle smile, reclining elegantly on floating white stone steps inside a minimalist white studio. She wears a delicate soft-pink tailored skirt suit with refined texture and clear pointed-toe pumps. Behind her is a large-scale tonal portrait of her face rendered in abstract minimalist artistic brushstrokes. Professional soft studio lighting, ultra-high detail, hyper-realism, refined calm luxury magazine style.
prompt.negative_prompt: celebrity likeness, public figure likeness, exact facial identity, explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, recognizable designer logo, trademark text, blurry, low quality, distorted anatomy, warped steps, watermark, text, signature

assets.name: pink-chanel-floating-steps-editorial.jpg
assets.usage: Reference the approved adult model styling, pink suit, clear pumps, floating steps, tonal portrait artwork, and minimalist lighting; replace named brand styling with generic luxury tailoring.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the required reference image. Preserve the face-and-style reference, pose, pink suit silhouette, steps, artwork, lighting, and environment. Use only an approved adult identity, keep likeness replaceable, replace brand names/logos with generic tailoring, and keep artwork typography-free.
